Footer.description: Don't waste time — take the first step toward your dream!
Footer.small_description: The AlexFisherWay project is a training course for self-employment in the fishing industry. It is not an employment agency or a crewing agency and does not guarantee employment of graduates.

Index.meta_description: Training course for employment in the fishing industry
Index.benefits_title: An ideal opportunity for men willing to work with their hands and support their families
Index.benefits_money_description: Earn up to €10,000 per month working on modern fishing vessels!
Index.benefits_housing_description: On Norwegian vessels the employer takes care of everything: accommodation, meals and flights. Salary is clean — no extra costs for you!
Index.benefits_experience_title: Possible without experience — we'll teach you everything!
Index.benefits_experience_description: Start working as a seafisher from zero — we'll teach you everything you need for employment and prepare you for your new profession!
Index.steps_follow_description: By taking the course, you will receive the most valuable materials to prepare for employment in the fishing fleet of Norway and other EU countries.
Index.steps_documents_description: Using our step-by-step materials and plan, you prepare and submit your papers to the required authorities.
Index.steps_ready_description: With documents prepared and fishing vessel contacts in hand, you can easily secure a place on a suitable ship.
Index.creator_description:
My name is Alexey and I personally advanced from a beginner to a navigator on a crab fishing vessel in Norway. I know how difficult it is to understand all the requirements, prepare the paperwork and find an employer. Over the years I have gathered:
  • Verified employer contacts.
  • Personal interview experience.
  • A complete understanding of what is required to succeed in this industry.
My goal is to help you avoid mistakes and make your sea journey as smooth and successful as possible.

Index.faq_first_title: How will this course help me get a job in the fishing fleet?
Index.faq_first_description: The AlexFisherWay course is a step-by-step plan for employment on crab fishing vessels and processing plants in Norway. We provide all the tools and knowledge you need to get hired successfully, advice on adaptation and medical exams, and contacts with employers not only in Norway but also in Ireland, Denmark and the UK, since Norway alone may not have enough vessels for everyone.
Index.faq_second_description: The course is aimed at EU citizens or holders of a residence permit in the EU and those who have the right to work in Norway, Ireland, Denmark or the UK. If you meet these criteria, the course will help you obtain a job in the fishing fleet.
Index.faq_third_title: What are the health requirements to work on a vessel?
Index.faq_third_description: For employment in the fishing fleet you must pass a medical examination to obtain a Norwegian maritime certificate. We will explain in detail how to go through this process and which documents are required.
Index.faq_fourth_title: How can I obtain a medical certificate to work on maritime vessels in Norway?
Index.faq_fourth_description: To obtain the medical certificate you must be examined by an accredited doctor who will carry out the necessary tests and checks. In our course we present all the steps to help you pass the medical certificate successfully.
Index.faq_fifth_title: Do I need experience on fishing vessels to get a job in this field?
Index.faq_fifth_description: Work experience on fishing vessels is encouraged but not mandatory. Many employers look for staff with experience in related fields such as fish processing or other marine industry activities. The key is the willingness to work in physically demanding conditions and to adapt quickly.
Index.faq_sixth_title: How long will it take to get a job?
Index.faq_sixth_description: The time from the start of training to employment depends on your efforts, your willingness to complete all stages and the availability of vacancies. However, with our course you will receive all the tools and support you need to significantly accelerate the process.
Index.faq_seventh_title: What if I don't speak Norwegian?
Index.faq_seventh_description: Language barriers are not a problem. In our course we show how easy it is to start working even if you don't speak Norwegian, because statistically 90% of Norwegians speak English as a second language. Three lessons in the course are dedicated to learning English from scratch, including maritime English and an interview model to help you adapt faster to shipboard work.
